item.title: Whiskers 0.8.43
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.43

### Recording Hotkeys

  • Double-tap a single-key recording shortcut like Fn to switch into hands-free dictation
  • Press either recording hotkey again while hands-free recording is active to finalize without reaching for the HUD
  • Improved hotkey guidance in Settings so hands-free behavior is clearer when your shortcut supports it

    • ### Reliability

  • Improved Bluetooth microphone startup so recording is more reliable when wireless audio devices wake up slowly
  • Reduced missed starts by warming up local dictation engines before you begin speaking
  • Fixed very short hands-free recordings so intentional finalizes are handled correctly instead of being treated like cancels

    • ### App Icon

  • Refreshed the Whiskers app icon with the new Liquid Glass look
